_comment: Workflows the admin editor can open and the assistant can run. `file` is the published copy (a commit on main is a version). `status`: published (default) or retired (kept for old conversations, hidden everywhere else). routing: true = suggests services; false = a form whose answers go to staff. group: the admin Workflows row and site menu item it belongs to, "assistant" (Resource Assistant) or "assessment" (Vision Assessment).

flows.title: Referral finder
flows.description: The questions the voice and chat assistant and the directory's Find services ask, and how each answer moves organizations up or down.

flows.title: V360 TECH interest form
flows.description: The V360 TECH community interest form (lionsservices.org/programs/lions-denn/v360-interest) as a form-style workflow: the assistant asks each question, reads back phone numbers and emails, and sends the answers to the Lions Services team. Shared by its own link and QR code.
usedBy: Voice and chat assistant (its own link: /f/v360-interest)

flows.title: Vision Assessment
flows.description: A short, voice-first check of how vision affects everyday tasks (reading, faces, getting around, light, screens, daily living), plus eye-care history and what help the person wants. Answers go to the Lions Services team. Not a medical exam. Starter questions for Lions Services to review.
